title: Learning sample count budget
statement: For every $n,\ell\in\mathbb{N}$ and every rational learning parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq \frac12$, let $M$ be the number $2^\ell$ times the sum of the number of subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$ and $\lceil\log_2\lceil2/\delta\rceil\rceil$. Then $2^M{}^{\!0}$ is not the asserted quantity; explicitly, $2^{\#}\exp\!\left(-M 2^{-\ell}\right)\leq\delta$, where $\# $ denotes the number of subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$.
caveat: The conclusion is rendered using $\# $ for the monomial count; the sample count $M$ is defined in the statement.
